events.outcome: The old AED10-per-quarter framing is not needed for the current normalized rule. Current e& pages state lifetime validity with continued use and a 12-month retention/revival window after non-use; exact minimum annual cash cost is therefore left unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: e& UAE Wasel is a prepaid line with lifetime validity tied to continued use. Current pages show prepaid SIM benefits and e& app/self-care account management.

keep.action: Keep using the line by recharging, making or receiving calls, or sending SMS. If the line becomes unused, e& says the number is retained for 12 months and can be revived during that period by a recharge or call.

data.chinaActivation: UAE subscriber registration rules apply; overseas-first acquisition is not assumed.
data.payment: e& UAE app/self-care and recharge channels.
data.roamingSms: Wasel supports international roaming; current FAQ explicitly says incoming SMS while roaming is free.
data.refund: If unused, the line is retained for 12 months before final release; exact post-release recovery not guaranteed.
data.tariffSummary: Free lifetime validity while the line is used; if unused, number retained 12 months and revivable by recharge or call.
